text:
You’re looking for a full-stack web app that can search affiliate products, work on desktop and mobile, and use GPT-based functionality that can be calibrated as more data comes in.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building web applications with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, and Tailwind CSS. For this kind of project, I’d focus on creating a clean product experience around the AI layer so the user flow feels simple, fast, and reliable, while the backend is structured to support future tuning as your data grows.

A recent project that’s relevant here was a multilingual documentation site for Gridbeam Robotics. I built a docs site in 4 languages with instant search, using Next.js, MDX, and Algolia. One result from that work was reducing support tickets by 27%. That project required careful information structure, search behavior, and a UI that stayed usable across different content states, which maps well to an AI-assisted product search experience.

I also worked on a booking platform for Pulsebox Studios, where I built a white-label class booking app with subdomains, timetables, and memberships using Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and Stripe. That project onboarded 64 studios in 6 months and reached 71% checkout conversion. I mention it because it involved full-stack product development, user flows, and a polished frontend connected to business logic and payments.

For your app, I’d be comfortable working from the Figma designs and turning them into a responsive desktop and mobile interface. I can also help shape the API layer, data model, and integration points needed for GPT-driven responses and product search. If you want, we can discuss how to structure the experience, how calibration should work as more data is added, and what the MVP should include first.

I’d be glad to talk through the project in more depth and help you map out a practical build plan.
